why.A: Two-column layout stacks cleanly on mobile with full-width tap targets and the next section peeks on desktop, but the static arch illustration carries no time cue, so the pinned-clock scroll story starts from nothing.
why.B: Full-width headline and illustration push the next section entirely below the desktop fold and stretch the subhead to roughly 90 characters per line, and like A it gives no clock hook for the scroll story.
why.C: The 05.30 card is high-contrast white text on dark green, reads as real text, peeks above the mobile fold as a scroll invitation and is the natural seed for the pinned clock, though its muted chairs and small mono label on dark green are low-contrast.

fix: Raise the small light-grey monospace price-terms line ('Vendor kalian bayar langsung; pelunasan fee kami setelah acara') to body size and at least 4.5:1 contrast, because it is the anti-fraud reassurance and is currently the least legible text in the hero on both viewports.
